title: Who won Ludwig’s Streamer Games 2026? Complete results, final standings, and winning team
summary_full: Ludwig's Streamer Games 2026 wrapped up after two days of competition at USC in Los Angeles. Team Worldwide finished first with 72 points, beating seven other creator teams. Ludwig praised the squad for dominating every event, while the final standings also sparked mixed reactions online. Here's the complete leaderboard, the winning roster, and what Ludwig said after announcing the champions during his livestream.
